episodes.title: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.summary: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

episodes.title: First Dance
episodes.summary: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.title: Spoonful
episodes.summary: Reacher and Finlay's investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.title: In a Tree
episodes.summary: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.title: No Apologies
episodes.summary: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Papier
episodes.summary: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.title: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.summary: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.title: Pie
episodes.summary: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

episodes.title: ATM
episodes.summary: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.title: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.summary: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.title: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.summary: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.summary: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.title: Burial
episodes.summary: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.summary: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.title: The Man Goes Through
episodes.summary: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.title: Fly Boy
episodes.summary: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O'Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends' murder.

episodes.title: Persuader
episodes.summary: Reacher must go undercover to rescue an informant being held by a haunting foe from his past.

episodes.title: Truckin'
episodes.summary: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.title: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.summary: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck's trust.

episodes.title: Dominique
episodes.summary: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.title: Smackdown
episodes.summary: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.summary: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.title: L.A. Story
episodes.summary: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.summary: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

episodes.title: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.summary: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.title: Cage Fight
episodes.summary: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.summary: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.summary: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.title: Bridge
episodes.summary: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.title: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.summary: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Vote for Sampson
episodes.summary: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been looking for. Meanwhile, Jacob learns that their problems are just beginning when Plum's sources come through with some timely information.

episodes.title: Cut
episodes.summary: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob go on the attack as the real extent of the plot emerges. Reacher confronts those responsible for Anna's death, Jacob is forced to face the truth, and Plum has a chance to redeem herself.
